description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 the champion stage, §5.13 boss 3): Harrok the Unbowed in the Moot's ring (an arena boss: world.stonehold.moot_arena, MootArena). Faction harrok_clan; he holds his ground at peace (stand_down_when) until the giant steps into the ring (world.area.moot_engage) - then the honour duel - and for good after the talk ending (boss.harrok.outcome yielded_talk). Once his outcome is settled he no longer comes to the ring.
